manifest.timestampSource: RPC log blockTimestamp; interpolated only when absent
manifest.scope: Earliest native-USDC or ERC20-USDC paired pool per token created in window, across the two configured Arc Uniswap v3/v4 factories; not token deployment or pre-migration curves

sessionFindings.scope: Consolidated session findings; original rows/configuration remain the 90% ATH delay/TP matrix.

configuration.poolAgeDefinition: Entry timestamp minus original pool creation timestamp
configuration.conditionalDeadlines: Both measured from entry; switch to filled-TP deadline only after actual partial sale fills
configuration.perfectCheckDefinition: Reject all 16 provider-flagged honeypots before entry, with no check fee or false positives. All 16 have positive GMGN snapshot flags; no buy→sell simulation confirmed them. Unknown flags remain clear in the main case. Delay is measured from first active liquidity.
configuration.delayedScreeningInterpretation: Primary: screen at original +4 decision and delay those entries to +8. Also show secondary screening re-evaluated with +8 features.

honeypotLabelProvenance.definition: Provider flags applied by the replay, not independently validated sell failures
honeypotLabelProvenance.supplements: GoPlus and AVE supplement unresolved fields
honeypotLabelProvenance.labelTiming: Current snapshots assumed available throughout historical trading
honeypotLabelProvenance.mainUnknownPolicy: Assume selling succeeds subject to liquidity, tax and modeled execution
honeypotLabelProvenance.unknownBlockedPolicy: Assume unknown honeypot flags block selling
honeypotLabelProvenance.perfectCheckScope: Reject the 16 provider-flagged tokens before entry; unclassified-token detection is not established

configuration.delayInterpretation: Modeled execution latency from first active liquidity; not intentional strategy waiting or production configuration
